title: Gold-reference construction and source-access parity controls
author: Faye Niu
purpose: Specify the staged construction, agreement, adjudication, freeze, scoring and source-access parity controls required before C0-C3 outputs may be compared against a common reference.

status.interpretation: Author synthesis of the current project evaluation contract and locally admitted methodological sources. The exhibit defines a planned control process; it does not demonstrate that the process has been executed or that any condition is accurate, reliable or superior.

inputs.role: Supports the distinction between observed agreement, chance-corrected reliability and validity; task/design assumptions; prevalence, bias and unitising limitations; and rejection of coefficient-as-truth reasoning.
Supports separate human annotation of citation completeness and whether cited passages support statements; benchmark values are not transferred.
Supports versioned records of data, code, procedures, metrics and reporting needed for reproducible empirical work; reproducibility is not treated as truth or validity.
Supports versioned documentation of purpose, composition, collection, external resources, intended use and maintenance for the frozen reference bundle.
Supports documented test sets, metrics, measurement assumptions, human-subject safeguards and internal-independent or external assessment; it does not certify this procedure.

stage_traceability.required_control: Version the codebook, typed label schema, eligible-source rules and source availability cutoff before labelling or scoring.
Two authorised domain reviewers independently label the same frozen source bundle and retain separate records until agreement is measured.
Record canonical value or missing state, evidence eligibility, sourceability, period, claim support, report-section requirement and exact locator.
Report raw agreement and use a task-appropriate chance-corrected statistic only if the sample, labels and design support it; otherwise record null with a reason.
Resolve each disagreement against the frozen passage with a recorded reason, disagreement category and versioned codebook change where needed.
Freeze the adjudicated reference, codebook, source bundle and manifest hash before scoring; manual and system outputs remain evaluated conditions, not truth.
Score against the same frozen reference, blind to condition where practicable, and record unavoidable unblinding or deviations.

Apply the same definitions, period, eligible source window and gold reference; record inaccessible/deleted/paywalled/login-only/later-published states; separate availability from retrieval; reject after-cutoff support.

limitations: The exhibit is conceptual and non-empirical; it contains no result value, sample size, acceptance threshold, condition ranking, timing, cost or user-outcome claim.
The current evaluation protocol is draft-for-domain/ethics review, and the gold/reference is not yet constructed or frozen; no empirical score may be inferred from this exhibit.
Two reviewers and high agreement do not make labels true. Reliability is distinct from validity, and chance-corrected coefficients require task- and design-specific assumptions.
Adjudication can introduce or preserve domain bias; every resolution reason and definition change must remain versioned and auditable.
Equal information access can be imperfect where sources are inaccessible, deleted, paywalled, login-only or published later; deviations must be recorded rather than hidden.
Publication or availability time is distinct from retrieval time. Material unavailable by the reporting cutoff cannot support the historical claim even if retrieved later.
Manual C0 and system C1-C3 outputs are comparison conditions, not an independent gold reference.
The complete plain-text companion provides linear reading-order access; no claim is made that a downstream dissertation PDF is tagged.
